name: Fountain Chamber, Tartarus
description: Added Chamber: Restore some Heart amidst the gloom. (Adds the Fountain Chamber to Tartarus.)

name: Underworld Fountains, Purified
description: Underworld Renovation: Fountains provide +10% more Healing than usual.

name: Underworld Fountains, Holy
description: Underworld Renovation: Fountains provide +20% more Healing than usual.

name: Fountain Chamber, Asphodel
description: Added Chamber: Restore some Heart amid the searing heat. (Adds the Fountain Chamber to Asphodel.)

name: Fountain Chamber, Elysium
description: Added Chamber: Restore some Heart amid the lush environs. (Adds the Fountain Chamber to Elysium.)

description: Underworld Renovation: Chambers may contain an Infernal Trove. Trove rewards: 100 Obol / 100 Heart / 50 Darkness / 25 Gemstones

description: Underworld Renovation: Each Infernal Trove contains more. Trove rewards: 125 Obol / 125 Heart / 100 Darkness / 50 Gemstones

description: Underworld Renovation: Each Infernal Trove contains even more. Trove rewards: 150 Obol / 150 Heart / 150 Darkness / 75 Gemstones

description: Underworld Renovation: Chambers may contain urns with 5 Obol.

description: Underworld Renovation: Chambers may contain urns with 15 Obol.

description: Underworld Renovation: Switch Keepsakes between Underworld regions.

name: Fated List of Minor Prophecies
description: Special Item: The Fates reward whomever moves things along...

description: Pact Stipulation: Unlocks the final rank of Extreme Measures ... if you dare.

name: Contractor's Desk, Deluxe
description: Special Item: Give the House Contractor a break (and new jobs...)

description: Underworld Renovation: Claiming Chthonic Key chamber rewards gives you +1 Fated Authority / Fated Persuasion.

description: Underworld Renovation: Claiming Gemstones chamber rewards gives you +20 Obol.

description: Underworld Renovation: Chambers may contain an Infernal Gate.

name: Rod of Fishing
description: Special Item: Scoop creatures from the Underworld's rivers...

description: House Decor: Authorizes playback of music pieces from the vault.

description: Special Item: (Re)authorizes entry into the administrative chamber.

description: Sealed Document: Allow Achilles to return to Elysium.
